source.mainFunction:
1) 비타민B1 : 탄수화물과 에너지 대사에 필요.
2) 비타민B2 : 체내 에너지 생성에 필요.
3) 비타민B6 : 단백질 및 아미노산 이용에 필요, 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요.
4) 비타민B12 : 정상적인 엽산 대사에 필요.
5) 비타민C : 결합조직 형성과 기능유지에 필요, 철의 흡수에 필요, 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요.
6) 비타민D : 칼슘과 인이 흡수되고 이용되는데 필요, 뼈의 형성과 유지에 필요, 골다공증발생 위험 감소에 도움을 줌. 
7) 비타민E : 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요.
8) 비타민K : 정상적인 혈액응고에 필요, 뼈의 구성에 필요. 
9) 나이아신 : 체내 에너지 생성에 필요.　
10) 판토텐산 : 지방, 탄수화물, 단백질 대사와 에너지 생성에 필요. 
11) 엽산 : 세포와 혈액생성에 필요, 태아 신경관의 정상 발달에 필요, 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요. 
12) 비오틴 : 지방, 탄수화물, 단백질 대사와 에너지 생성에 필요.

2) 비타민B1 : 표시량(100mg/1000mg)의 80~180%
3) 비타민B2 : 표시량(50mg/1000mg)의 80~180%
4) 비타민B6 : 표시량(50mg/1000mg)의 80~150%
5) 비타민B12 : 표시량(200ug/1000mg)의 80~180%
6) 비타민C : 표시량(100mg/1000mg)의 80~150%
7) 비타민D : 표시량(10ug/1000mg)의 80~180%
8) 비타민E : 표시량(11mg α-TE/1000mg)의 80~150%
9) 비타민K : 표시량(55ug/1000mg)의 80~180%
10) 나이아신 : 표시량(50mg/1000mg)의 80~150%　 
11) 판토텐산 : 표시량(50mg/1000mg)의 80~180%

source.caution:
섭취 시 목에 걸릴 수 있으므로 반드시 물과 함께 섭취하십시오.
섭취 시 위장장애, 소화불량의 증상이 있을 경우 섭취를 중단하십시오.
개인의 신체 상태에 따라 이상 증상이 생길 경우 섭취를 중단하십시오.
섭취 전 제품에 이상이 있는 경우 섭취를 금하십시오.
특정 원료 성분에 알레르기 체질은 원료 성분을 확인 후 섭취하십시오.
고칼슘혈증이 있거나 의약품 복용 시 전문가와 상담하십시오.
이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담하십시오.
항응고제 등 복용 시 전문가와 상담하십시오.
손발 따끔거림, 작열감 또는 저림 등의 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담하십시오.
과량 섭취하지 않도록 주의하십시오.
신장질환이 있는 경우 섭취 전 전문가와 상담하십시오.

Health Functional FoodNiacin 50mgBiotin 400μgVitamin B1 100mgVitamin B12 200μgVitamin B2 50mgVitamin B6 50mgVitamin C 100mgVitamin D 10μgVitamin E 11mgVitamin K 55μgFolate 680μgPantothenic acid 50mgOnce a day

에너지투비타민Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Vitamin K · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 코스맥스바이오(주) · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 50mg of Niacin, 400μg of Biotin, 100mg of Vitamin B1, 200μg of Vitamin B12, 50mg of Vitamin B2, 50mg of Vitamin B6, 100mg of Vitamin C, 10μg of Vitamin D, 11mg of Vitamin E, 55μg of Vitamin K, 680μg of Folate, 50mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 50mg Niacin, 400μg Biotin, 100mg Vitamin B1, 200μg Vitamin B12, 50mg Vitamin B2, 50mg Vitamin B6, 100mg Vitamin C, 10μg Vitamin D, 11mg Vitamin E, 55μg Vitamin K, 680μg Folate, 50mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 코스맥스바이오(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin K
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Needed for the structure of bone
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (50mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (400μg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (100mg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (200μg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (50mg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (50mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (100mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin E labelled (11mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin K labelled (55μg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Folate labelled (680μg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (50mg / 1000mg), 80~180%

Coliform Negative

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Vitamin K · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

  • Biotin

  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism

    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6

  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin K
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Needed for the structure of bone
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
